documents.title: Orion P1 policy
documents.text: Orion P1 incidents must be acknowledged within 17 minutes. Escalate to the Aurora support team.

documents.title: Atlas backup policy
documents.text: Atlas backups run every 6 hours and are retained for 14 days. Restore drills run each Friday.

documents.title: Cedar support hours
documents.text: Cedar support operates from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC on weekdays. Weekend support is for P1 incidents only.

documents.title: Maple incident INC-204
documents.text: Maple incident INC-204 was caused by an expired TLS certificate. The assigned owner is Priya.

documents.title: Birch rollback policy
documents.text: For Birch, rollback when the error rate exceeds 4 percent for 5 minutes. The rollback owner is the release captain.

documents.title: Willow API limits
documents.text: The Willow API allows 120 requests per minute per tenant. Clients should use exponential backoff after HTTP 429.

documents.title: Pioneer cache policy
documents.text: Pioneer query results expire after 10 minutes. Source updates invalidate cached query results.

documents.title: Harbor incident INC-881
documents.text: Harbor incident INC-881 is resolved. The root cause was database connection exhaustion.
